Current status — 2026-10-05: **incomplete**. The user authorized direct primitive-column integration after the measured window. Actual JS/Native candidate storage lifecycle and query are implemented with affine Type Main/Aux owners retained. Current v4 lifecycle controls pass 52 literal full-field observations/backend, three intended type negatives/backend, and a compiling omitted-mark mutation. Actual query/command controls pass 40 observations for four backend/schema subjects, detecting both compiling query-order and flag-membership mutants at intended checkpoints. All22 connected gates and speed targets remain incomplete: current full Host checking exceeds the unchanged five-second limit. No new law, dependency, compiler/kernel change or production adoption.

Global20/20 measured attempts remain exhausted (18 canonical logs plus two interruptions). Canonical budget aliases are restored to the accepted segment limit5 for consistency; this grants no renewed physical allowance. Prior deadlines and proposed caps below are historical. JS/TS<=1 and Native/TS<=0.5 on equivalent work remain mandatory.

Evidence: [lifecycle controls](https://github.com/dearlordylord/bendvy/tree/master/experiments/s-prep/primitive-storage-integration), [candidate integration](https://github.com/dearlordylord/bendvy/tree/master/experiments/s-prep/primitive-columns-candidate), [current integration report](https://github.com/dearlordylord/bendvy/blob/master/docs/reports/primitive-columns-integration.md). Public detached column alignment remains an explicit production follow-up; finite tests do not establish universal refinement.

The historical draft below records earlier proposals, evidence and expired limits. Its17-path catalogue is no longer an edit whitelist, and its old deadline does not authorize execution.

---

Draft for discussion; this issue does not approve a replacement measured contract or production API. Parent: #23; full performance: #21; specification: #1.

The current per-row callback builds ten curried provider closures. A bounded prototype uses erased provider binders in the callback type (`@-get`, `@-set`, etc.) and closed template callbacks. Adapter bodies and original callback blocks remain intact; the new type contract gives direct saturated calls in generated JS.

Delivered evidence: [prototype and source reconstruction](https://github.com/dearlordylord/bendvy/blob/master/docs/research/static-provider-dispatch/README.md), [current registration receipts](https://github.com/dearlordylord/bendvy/blob/master/docs/research/static-provider-dispatch/registration-evidence.json), [short scope draft](https://github.com/dearlordylord/bendvy/blob/master/docs/design/static-provider-dispatch-plan.md), commit cd2463d.

Observed: two independently selected miniature callbacks returned85; captured runtime providers were rejected. Two positive/six negative portable controls passed, including cross-schema callbacks/setters, opaque owner inspection and public setters on an abstract owner. Four complete Motion/Health JS/Native records matched actually executed TS reference output; Native used O3/oneworker/GPUoff. The earlier named-route probe also matched six missing-ID0 fallback records. These are finite/type observations, not full22 gates, universal runtime refinement or performance acceptance. Full measurement-entry checking still exceeded5seconds.

Proposed work:

1. Review the callback contract and17-path runtime scope: existing13 paths, two measurement routes and two new static-client paths. Eight held-adapter callback type headers gain erased provider binders; bodies remain unchanged. Preserve arbitrary affine Type owners and the existing concrete payloads; no Data-only restriction or import secrecy. Validate independently authored closed callbacks and supported registration paths.
2. Resolve five-second entry checking, freeze exact runtime/supporting closures, and adapt each control to the actual consumer. Run all22 fresh connected gates, including nested suppressed-owner updates, rollback, stale/torn transactions, exact marks/inverses and handles from two actual factory-created runtime worlds. Never accept a timeout or an unused mutation as detection.
3. After a reviewed experiment contract, compare equivalent Dense256/64tick/B64/full65 work on both schemas. Retain JS/TS<=1.00, Native/TS<=0.50, O3/oneworker/GPUoff, two unknown-noise qualification repeats and existing conservative/nonregression rules. Do not replace the original authored callback algorithm or exclude mandatory work to meet a target.

Complete this bounded slice only with actual full-gate receipts and qualified comparative evidence. Keep the full five-family/three-size product matrix, production API and approved-law proofs as explicit follow-ups. No compiler/kernel/dependency changes or new law approval.

Budget: global15/20 attempts consumed, five remaining. The current user window ends2026-10-05T18:55:07Z; issue creation is not a renewed allowance. The old loop stopped after two matching checker failures. A new segment must not conceal those failures or reset history. This draft is not ready-for-agent measured execution until scope and execution recovery are resolved.
title: S-DISPATCH: Validate static providers for opaque affine ECS callbacks
